_comment: How each car looks in the Unreal client (Source/SimCruise/*/Presentation). Physics stays in data/cars/<id>.json. Boxes and points use the Unreal vehicle frame: X forward, Y right, Z up, metres, origin midway between the axles at the physics body origin. Colours are "#rrggbb" sRGB. Roles: see SimCruiseCarMaterialRoles.h. Every value that copies a real car names its source.

nb2001_aaron.dials_note: The NB cluster's five dials (Godot vehicle frame, metres: x right, y up, z rearward): hubs and scales fitted to the model's own dial faces in a 1600x900 cockpit capture (each needle's pivot, and the angle of 0, 20, 80 and 140 mph and of 0, 4 and 8 thousand r/min), each turned to the driver's eye. The model keeps its faces ("face": false): a needle mesh turns over each. The model's own white needles are part of the dash mesh and stay at rest under them. The model sits on each car's mount height (0.545 m for Aaron's car, 0.51 m for the stock NBs), so the stock cars' hubs are 3.5 cm lower. Left to right: fuel, tachometer (red from 7000), coolant (top), speedometer (0-150 mph, US), oil pressure.
nb2001_aaron.credit: "Mazda MX-5 (NB) convertible HQ interior" by Nieve5677 (https://sketchfab.com/niev), CC BY 4.0
nb2001_aaron.steering_ratio_source: 15:1 overall, power rack, 2.6 turns lock to lock (GoAuto, 2001 MX-5 review; the NB power rack is the same 1999-2005).

clock.source: display_baseColor.png paints 5:12 between x 650-990 and y 15-112 of 1024 x 128; the dash shows it upside down (seven-segment 5 reads as 2), as 2:15. The NB clock is a 12-hour green LCD. The same mesh maps the texture's wrapped copy (V -0.91..0) onto the radio's LCD, which the stock radio uses for the tuned station: WLRN, Miami's public radio, at 91.3 FM.

nb2001_aaron.roles_source: 'white' is the cluster's numerals and ticks and the console's labels (meshes only on the dash, x -9..47, y -83..-49 cm in the model): backlit like the real panel, 25 nits, which daylight in the cabin drowns and night shows.

steering_wheel.source: Centre and column from the model (the rig's own ring search, which found the 0.162 m horn ring); radius 0.185 m: the NB's 370 mm wheel, measured on the model's rim (estimate).

nb2001_aaron.addons_source: The owner's car in their two photographs (D:\sc\miata-ref, 12 November 2026): a black roll bar (hoop with a diagonal brace and stays to the rear deck) whose top is about level with the windscreen top; the soft top folded down behind it; a gloss-black single-element wing almost as wide as the car, its trailing edge raised, on short black uprights with silver bases, small silver-grey rounded tips, about 8 cm above the trunk lid near its rear edge (close-ups of IMG_7407 and IMG_2356).

wheel_design.source: The owner's wheels in their photographs: silver cross-spoke mesh face, a wide polished lip (about 2 in), a deep dish and a dark Mazda centre cap, about 15x8; the tyre is the car file's size.

nb2001_aaron.seats_source: The owner's car has black Sparco bucket seats with a white logo on the headrest; the model's seats ('interior_fourth') are recoloured black cloth until bucket seats are modelled.

mustang65.dials_note: The 1965 Mustang's standard cluster: a straight (ribbon) speedometer 0-120 mph across the middle, the fuel gauge in the left pod and the coolant temperature in the right. The model's cluster face is a blank flat oblong, so each gets a drawn face. Centres ray-cast onto the model's face from the driver's eye at the pods and band seen in a 1600x900 cockpit capture (Godot vehicle frame, before the 0.9187 lateral fit).

engine_sound.source: Ford 289 V8: firing order 1-5-4-2-6-3-7-8, cylinders 1-4 on the right (passenger) bank and 5-8 on the left (Ford service manual numbering); dual exhausts, the driver's-side pipe nearer. Bank gains 1.0 / 0.62 are an estimate (no recording synchronised with rpm).

mustang65.credit: "1965 Ford Mustang Convertible" by Kristian LaGrange (https://sketchfab.com/kristian123), CC BY 4.0
mustang65.steering_ratio_source: 21.7:1 manual, 3.73 turns lock to lock (Ford specifications, as in chassis).

paint.name: Atlas paint (author texture)
paint.source: The model's atlas carries its own body colour; 1965 enamel was solid (non-metallic) with a heavier orange peel than modern clear coats.

badges.note: FORD letters on the bonnet lip

role_areas.note: left tail-lamp lens segments (in the body's texture atlas; the chrome bezel reaches outside the box and stays)
right tail-lamp lens segments (in the body's texture atlas)

screen.note: The C8's 12.3 in digital cluster in its Tour layout: the model's picture (stored upside down: flip_v) shows 0 MPH and a lit tachometer arc to about 1000 r/min. A material erases the painted arc and draws the live one (0 r/min at 142 degrees left of 12 o'clock, 37.5 degrees a thousand: the 4 at the top, the 7 at 121 degrees right) and the speed in the empty centre above MPH. Pixel positions measured on the texture.

engine_sound.source: GM LT2 6.2 L V8: firing order 1-8-7-2-6-5-4-3, odd cylinders on the left (driver's side) bank and even on the right (GM numbering); quad tips, the driver's-side pair nearer. Bank gains 1.0 / 0.62 are an estimate (no recording synchronised with rpm).
